# MDS Associates

> > MDS Associates is a wholesale distributor of consumable personal protective equipment (PPE) and workplace safety products from leading manufacturers including Superior Glove, PIP, Portwest, and SHOWA.

MDS Associates specializes in industrial hand protection, cut-resistant gloves, biodegradable nitrile gloves, and sustainable PPE solutions for diverse industries including manufacturing, utilities, cannabis cultivation, and healthcare. The company emphasizes ANSI-compliant safety standards and eco-friendly product innovations.

## Key Topics

- Personal Protective Equipment (PPE)
- Industrial Hand Protection
- Cut-Resistant Gloves
- Biodegradable Nitrile Gloves
- Superior Glove Products
- PIP (Protective Industrial Products)
- Portwest Safety Gear
- SHOWA EBT Technology

- Workplace Safety Compliance
- Touchscreen-Compatible Gloves
- Cannabis Cultivation PPE
- Cross-Contamination Prevention
